pr_metadata.title: feat: Add Cygnal integration
pr_metadata.description:
- [ ] This change is worth documenting at https://docs.all-hands.dev/
- [ ] Include this change in the Release Notes. If checked, you **must** provide an **end-user friendly** description for your change below

**End-user friendly description of the problem this fixes or functionality this introduces.**
Adds Gray Swan's [Cygnal](https://www.grayswan.ai/product/cygnal) monitor to OpenHands as a new option for the `SecurityAnalyzer`.

---
**Summarize what the PR does, explaining any non-trivial design decisions.**
- Adds functionality to pass the event stream into the `SecurityAnalyzer` base class (so analyzers can track conversation history)
- Integrates the `SecurityAnalyzer` class with Gray Swan's Cygnal [API](https://docs.grayswan.ai/monitor-requests/monitor)

---
**Link of any specific issues this addresses:**

gold_comments.issue_summary: I'm pretty sure that because the base security analyzer has a `set_event_stream` method this conditional will always be true.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added conditional `if self.event_stream and hasattr(self.security_analyzer, 'set_event_stream')` is present at openhands/runtime/base.py:202–204.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would flag this because the base security analyzer already defines `set_event_stream`, so the `hasattr` check is unnecessary and suggests confusion about class hierarchy.
gold_comments._reviewer_comment_full: I'm pretty sure that because the base security analyzer has a `set_event_stream` method this conditional will always be true.
